idea.idea: Canva Craft: Generating Festive Store Posters with Layout Planning
idea.angle: Canva's new image generation model plans text layout and design hierarchy before generating images, ending the mess of unreadable AI poster text for retail store promotions.
idea.audience_problem: Local business owners struggle to design sharp promotional banners and festive discount creatives without hiring expensive graphic designers.

hooks: AI image tools usually mangle text when you try making discount store posters.

Stop paying graphic designers for simple festive offer banners in your shop.

piece.title: Clear AI Poster Text with Canva Craft

piece.caption:
How to generate shop discount posters with clear text using Canva Craft Dream Lab.

Creating promotional banners for festival sales or stock clearances usually means struggling with distorted text in standard AI tools. Canva Craft fixes this by splitting the job into two steps: planning the layout hierarchy first, then generating the 2K image. Since it was trained on actual design templates, text stays legible. You can even edit individual text layers using Canva Magic without ruining the background graphic.

Where have you faced the biggest issues when generating promotion banners using AI?

claims.claim: Canva released its first image generation model named Canva Craft.
Canva Craft works in two stages: first planning spatial relationships, scale, hierarchy, and text, then generating the image.
The model supports up to 2K resolution images across 30 aspect ratios.
Canva Craft was trained on human-designed templates from Canva's library, including posters and menus.
Generated images can be converted into layered designs for precise editing without altering other parts.
Users can access Canva Craft on the platform under the Dream Lab tab.
